results.title: 1987 Dodge Ram 50 at No Reserve
results.description: This 1987 Dodge Ram 50 pickup is said to have remained registered to the original owner in Tennessee through 2025 and now shows 28k miles. It is finished in Gold Dust Metallic over tan vinyl and powered by a 2.0-liter G63B inline-four that drives the rear wheels through a three-speed automatic transmission. The truck has air conditioning and 14" steel wheels with bright trim rings. This Ram 50 is offered by the selling dealer at no reserve in Arkansas with a Carfax report and a Mississippi title.

results.title: 2019 Volvo S60 T6 R-Design Polestar Engineered at No Reserve
results.description: This 2019 Volvo S60 T6 R-Design is finished in Denim Blue Metallic over black Nappa leather and is powered by a twin-charged 2.0L inline-four linked to an eight-speed automatic transmission and an all-wheel-drive system. Features include the Protection Package Premier, as well as Polestar engine management software, 19" R-Design alloy wheels, LED lighting, a panoramic sunroof, parking sensors, heated power-adjustable front sport seats, a heated rear bench, dual-zone automatic climate control, a rearview camera, navigation, and touchscreen infotainment paired with a Harman Kardon sound system. This S60 has 166k miles and is offered at no reserve by the selling dealer with a clean Carfax report and a clean Pennsylvania title.
